# Inline demo with a syntax error

The scan must not throw on this: an unparseable inline block contributes no
imports and still renders, reporting its own error at runtime (see
`collectInlineImports`). The `live` block below is missing a closing brace.

```jsx live
import { DateTime } from "luxon";

export default function BrokenInlineDemo() {
  return <div>{DateTime.now().toISO()</div>;
```
